subject: Post-call: Cloud purchase ops & marketplace readiness (Skybridge)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@skybridge.io>, Skybridge Procurement <procurement@skybridge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Cloud purchase ops & marketplace readiness (Skybridge)

Hi Lisa — thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed set of next steps to close the commercial path: 

Call highlights: 
- Use case: Skybridge will embed LLM-powered summarization in your analytics dashboard for customers (internal API + consumer-facing features).
- Priority: latency-sensitive, multi-tenant, and strict audit logs.
- Procurement preference: Finance mentioned a preference for AWS Marketplace to simplify billing, but legal needs to confirm data residency/contract terms.

Procurement readiness checklist (quick):
1) Decision maker: Finance + Procurement (we have contacts listed below).
2) Payment method: card for pilot vs PO for enterprise contract (need timeline).
3) Marketplace interest: you indicated strong preference but asked about SKU granularity and reserved capacity.
4) Security/compliance: SOC2 + audit log export is required.

Attachments I included: redwood_procurement_checklist.pdf (procurement flow + required docs), marketplace_sku_matrix.csv (candidate SKUs and estimated monthly cost ranges).

Proposed next steps: 
- Lisa: Confirm who will own the PO/Marketplace decision and share any vendor intake form (if you have one) by Wed 6/23.
- Procurement: If Marketplace is viable, share the required accounting code and expected start-of-purchase date.
- Karthik: I'll loop you to confirm SKU availability and whether we can map a reserved capacity option to a Marketplace listing.
- Marcus: Can you provide a short pilot SKUs/pricing estimate we can include in the internal deck?

Happy to jump on a short follow-up with Procurement to walk through the Marketplace flow.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_procurement_checklist.pdf (attachment), marketplace_sku_matrix.csv (attachment)
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@skybridge.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Skybridge Procurement <procurement@skybridge.io>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cloud purchase ops & marketplace readiness (Skybridge)

Thanks Monica — great notes and appreciated the checklist. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Marketplace preference: Finance prefers Marketplace for standard purchases (card/commit via AWS Marketplace) to avoid manual POs for the pilot. For enterprise rollouts we typically do a PO/contract.
2) Timeline: Pilot procurement team wants to complete purchasing paperwork and payment method decision by end of July (target start Aug 1).
3) Legal/data residency: Legal flagged that any Marketplace listing must include clear language around data handling. They asked if we support regioned deployments and if audit logs can be retained for 12 months.

I attached our vendor intake form — please fill the technical and security sections (vendor_intake_form.docx). Also, can you confirm if Redwood has an approved standard Marketplace contract template or if we need to route to legal early?

On SKU: We want a single SKU that corresponds to pilot capacity (approx 200k tokens/month) and an option for reserved capacity later. If you can confirm SKU names and cost ranges we can evaluate with FinOps.

Lisa Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships | Skybridge Analytics

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.docx (attachment)

Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cloud purchase ops & marketplace readiness (Skybridge)

Thanks for the recap, Monica. A couple internal asks so we can move fast: 

- Monica: please prepare a short one-pager (1 slide) that maps the pilot SKU to expected monthly cost and a 3-month pilot estimate. We'll use this for the FinOps review.
- Karthik: can you confirm whether AWS Marketplace listing can expose both on-demand and reserved options (SKU + reserved capacity)? If so, what's lead time to create SKU entries and link to our billing account?
- Legal: if Marketplace contract needs additional language for data residency, we'll need to know the exact clause to assess. FYI I copied Lisa for awareness.

I'll also add a commercial owner to the deal in HubSpot and propose a short procurement walkthrough call for next week. Monica — please add the HubSpot link in the follow-up.

Marcus Lin
Sales Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Monica / Team — following up from our intake form review. We've attached a short procurement timeline and a list of documents we'll need for Marketplace onboarding:

- Completed vendor intake form (we received the initial file from Lisa).
- SOC2 attestation and link to audit report.
- Marketplace listing details: proposed SKU name, description, and monthly price bands.
- Invoice remit and accounting code for PO path (if we switch to PO later).

Timeline (high level):
- Intake + docs — 1 week for review.
- Legal review (if any contract redlines) — 1–2 weeks.
- Marketplace onboarding / SKU publish — 2–3 weeks after approvals.

If Redwood can provide a draft Marketplace listing and SOC2 link by next Tue (6/29) we can accelerate to have the pilot purchasable via Marketplace by Aug 1.

Procurement Team
Skybridge Analytics
